messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "if more than 4 days have passed, skip the missed dose"
set: ["if more than 4 days have passed, skip the missed dose", "skip the missed dose if more than 5 days have passed", "skip the missed dose if it has been more than 4 days since your last dose", "Skip the missed dose", "skip the missed dose if you are more than 12 hours late", "if more than 5 days late, skip missed dose and return to regular schedule", "take the missed dose if it is within 4 days after the missed dose", "skip missed dose if almost evening", "If you have missed the dose for the whole day, skip it", "if you take Horizant, skip the missed dose", "skip missed dose if almost time for next scheduled dose", "skip the missed dose and take next dose at usual time", "skip the missed dose and use next dose at regular time", "skip missed dose and return to regular schedule", "if next dose due in less than 2 days, skip missed dose and return to regular schedule", "4 days"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "skip the missed dose if more than 5 days have passed",
    "skip the missed dose if it has been more than 4 days since your last dose",
    "skip the missed dose if you are more than 12 hours late",
    "if more than 5 days late, skip missed dose and return to regular schedule",
    "skip missed dose if almost time for next scheduled dose",
    "skip the missed dose and take next dose at usual time",
    "skip missed dose and use next dose at regular time",
    "skip missed dose and return to regular schedule",
    "if next dose due in less than 2 days, skip missed dose and return to regular schedule"
  ],
  "alias": "skip the missed dose if more than 4 days have passed"
}
